reports.title: Coca-Cola Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance

guidance.heading: Outlook
section:
Current | Prior
Organic revenues (non-GAAP) | At least 5% growth | Approx. 5% growth
Comparable net revenues (non-GAAP) | •Approx. 1% currency tailwind1•Approx. 2% headwind from acquisitions and divestitures2 | •Approx. 1% currency tailwind1•2% to 3% headwind from acquisitions and divestitures2
Underlying effective tax rate (non-GAAP)3 | 19.7% | 19.9%
Comparable currency neutral EPS excluding acquisitions and divestitures (non-GAAP) | At least 9% growth | 7% to 8% growth
Comparable EPS (non-GAAP) | At least 11% growth, which includes:•Approx. 3% currency tailwind1•Approx. 1% headwind from acquisitions and divestitures2 | 9% to 10% growth, which includes:•Approx. 3% currency tailwind1•Approx. 1% headwind from acquisitions and divestitures2
